The main innovation is to control the valuation of p by relating it to Fourier coefficients of cusp forms with increasing level. This is possible as such valuations are Fourier coefficients of incoherent Eisenstein series with full level, and can be approximated by Fourier coefficients of coherent Eisenstein series with higher levels; This is the content of Theorem 2.5.
